title: Uruk Archaeological Site — Birthplace of Writing
full_text:
Start heading south to Samawa.
After lunch we will visit the UNESCO world heritage site, Uruk — an ancient city of Sumer that played a leading role in the early urbanization. Writing may have originated in Uruk around 3300 BC. Evidence from excavations includes extensive pottery and the earliest known tablets of writing.
Uruk is the home of the legendary king Gilgamesh, who is the hero of "The Epic of Gilgamesh".
Driving to Nasiriyah and checking in at the hotel.
Dinner of your choice and optional shisha time at the Nasiriyah corniche.
